description: Cross-platform MCP server for OBSBOT Tiny 2 (UVC) camera control

tool_signatures.name: obsbot_aim_at_pixel
tool_signatures.description: x, y, frameWidth, frameHeight, source (default "device"), camera?

tool_signatures.name: obsbot_capture_snapshot
tool_signatures.description: resolution (256–1920, default 640), quality (1–100, default 80), settleMs (0–15000, default 600), source (default "device"), camera? (source:"device" only)

tool_signatures.name: obsbot_gimbal_move
tool_signatures.description: yaw, pitch, roll (degrees, roll defaults 0), camera?

tool_signatures.name: obsbot_gimbal_move_speed
tool_signatures.description: yaw, pitch, roll (deg/s, clamped to ±150, roll defaults 0), autoStopMs (default 800), camera?

tool_signatures.name: obsbot_zoom_to_fit
tool_signatures.description: x, y, width, height, frameWidth, frameHeight, margin (default 0.1), source (default "device"), camera?
